run_ids_comment: A curated set: ten slots and two edge cases (the layout is in `slots` and `edge_cases`), not twenty runs.
`run_ids` lists the runs that exist for filled slots and edge cases. Filled by tools/judging_json.py from the result records in S3.
Pending slots name what they wait for. Runs a slot compares against (`bar_run_id`, `base_run_id`) and every other run are under `supporting_run_ids`.
`python tools/judging_json.py --slots-report` prints which slots are filled and checks them against `run_ids`.
